weeks.content:
Greet the teacher and friends
Share holiday stories kindly

Happy, sad, angry faces
Say how I feel with words

Stop, breathe, count to five
Ask for help calmly

Follow the game rules
No cheating in games

Line leader, plant keeper, book helper
Do my job daily

Handle books and toys with care
Return what I borrow

Eyes on the speaker
Raise my hand to talk

Say sorry and mean it
Accept sorry and move on

Families come in all sizes
Every family is special

Role play all term habits
Good manners badge ceremony
